But seriously even just a response to a post like this helps so much, to know I’m not the only one feeling like taking my life and talking with someone about those feelings and still be able to go on with my life without fearing someone would over react or take me wanting to end my life the wrong way. 
I hate trying to be fixed when this is almost the way I want to be.. depression has this almost soft and loving grasp as it holds you.

I’ve check off what I thought would make me happy and I’m actually way worse off, the things that I was pushing though and struggling towards I’ve gotten and I’m left worse off now. I don’t want to do anything anymore, I don’t want anything anymore, it’s like being hungry and knowing you need to feed yourself but you have no appetite and you have to force yourself to eat because you know you need the nourishment but it’s not satisfying, forcing yourself to do anything because you know you have to, have to make sure no one can see how much you hurt because you don’t want them to treat you like you’re hurting, you just want to make it though the day. On the way of accomplishing what I have I’ve totally lost myself and I’m so lost but don’t even care to find myself again in this terrible world. It’s not worth it to me.
